name: book_meeting
description: Books the discovery call on the real calendar and sends the invite. Call this only after check_availability has returned a slot in this conversation and the visitor has agreed to it, and only after you have spelled the email address back and been told it is right. start_utc must be copied exactly from a check_availability response. Never build a time yourself. On success the response is {ok: true, booking_uid, start_utc, label, speak} and you say the speak sentence. On failure the response is {ok: false, reason, speak} and you say the speak sentence exactly as written and then follow the rule for that reason in your instructions.

request_body_schema.description: Booking request for the SheryLabs discovery call event type.

start_utc.description: The exact start_utc string from the check_availability response for the slot the visitor agreed to, copied character for character. Never write this value yourself and never adjust it.

name.description: The visitor's full name as they gave it.

email.description: The visitor's email address, exactly as they confirmed it when you spelled it back to them.

notes.description: Optional. One or two sentences on what the visitor wants built, in their own words, so the call starts with context.
